Zoe Park: Hey team, Zoe here (joined today). Quick cloud onboarding asks: 
- Link billing `sandbox-billing-2026` to project `redwood-zoe-sbx` (expected spend ~<$25/mo)
- Grant my user `roles/storage.objectViewer` on bucket `redwood-embeddings-sbx` and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` but only on the test key `projects/redwood-test/locations/global/keyRings/sbx/cryptoKeys/zoe-key`
- Need region access for europe-west4 and asia-south1 to run small latency tests 
- TPU v2 quota +1 in europe-west4 for short run (manager approved)
- AWS cross-account read-only for acct `777888999000` and S3 ListObjects on `redwood-checkpoints-sbx` (72h temporary ok)
Also hitting Okta device-flow "invalid_grant" in gcloud CLI. Anyone seen this? Who should I tag for billing link + AWS role? Thanks!

Amit Shah: welcome Zoe! For billing tag @billing-team; I can start the billing link if you add me to project IAM. For Okta device-flow, try re-running `gcloud auth login` and re-enroll MFA.

Zoe Park: Amit added. Re-enrolled MFA and reran login; fixed the device flow issue.

Riley Brooks: Security/infra notes: since key is under test keyring we'll need security ack for KMS use. AWS role time-limited 72h is standard for cross-account. Manager approval for TPU noted.

Zoe Park: Manager is Riley Brooks (cc'ed). Data classification: synthetic prompts only. Riley confirmed.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-5401 created by Amit Shah. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5401

iam-bot: To apply roles I need the user principal. Zoe, confirm email. Also will we grant KMS role to your user or to `sa-zoe@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com` for CI?

Zoe Park: Email is `zoe.park@redwood.com`. Grant storage viewer to my user and KMS ENCR/DECR to `sa-zoe@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. AWS 72h temporary is fine.

ops-bot: Applied `roles/storage.objectViewer` to `zoe.park@redwood.com` at 1945678950. Requested KMS binding and TPU quota. AWS temp role request opened for account `777888999000` with 72h expiry.

sec-bot: Security ack for non-sensitive dev usage granted at 1945678970. Reminder: do not generate long-lived SA keys; use short-lived tokens.

Zoe Park: I can list bucket objects and ran a small encrypt/decrypt against the test key, works. Thanks! :tada:

ops-bot: TPU quota submitted; AWS role created. Closing follow-ups once quota active and role confirmed.

Zoe Park: Confirmed TPU v2 available and AWS S3 list works. All set for my first-week tests. Appreciate the help!
